All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AdminController
Controller for the admin UI.
Album
Album stores photo IDs (UUID) and computes derived values like photo count and date range.
AlbumController
Controller for Album view (photo grid, add/remove/move/copy/slideshow).
AlbumService
AlbumService handles album CRUD operations and photo management within albums.
AuthService
AuthService handles login logic.
DataStore
DataStore defines the contract for persistent data storage operations.
LoginController
Controller for the login screen.
ObjectDataStore
ObjectDataStore implements the DataStore interface using Java Object Serialization.
Photo
Photo model represents a single photo in the system.
Photos
Main JavaFX application entry point for Photos48.
PhotoService
PhotoService provides operations for managing individual Photo objects.
PhotoViewerController
Controller for Photo Viewer (image display, caption, tags, add/delete tags).
SceneManager
Simple scene manager to hold references to the DataStore.
SearchController
Controller for Search (by date range or tag pairs: single, AND, OR).
SearchService
SearchService provides flexible search capabilities for photos.
SessionService
SessionService manages the current logged-in user and handles save on logout/quit.
StockService
StockService initializes a "stock" user with sample photos on application first launch.
Tag
Tag represents a (type, value) pair attached to a photo.
TagService
TagService manages tag operations and enforces tag multiplicity rules.
TagType
TagType defines a tag type and its multiplicity rule.
TagType.Multiplicity
Multiplicity rule for tags.
User
User represents a user account in the system.
UserHomeController
Controller for User Home (list albums).
UserService
UserService provides user account management operations.
UsersIndex
Lightweight wrapper to track usernames (delegates to DataStore implementations).
